name: while
description: Deploy and share tools built with your AI agent: your team, a client or everyone. Each tool has its PostgreSQL database backed up every day, storage and scheduled jobs. Hosted in France.

interface.shortDescription: Share tools or put them online
interface.longDescription:
You built a tool with your AI. It works, but it stays in the conversation, and no one else can use it.

With while.sh, your AI deploys it, and the tool has its own address in 3 minutes. You choose who uses it. When you share it with your colleagues, only they can use it. A client or a supplier uses it with an access link, valid for 1, 7 or 30 days, and a password your AI never sees. Before it goes online for everyone, a person on your team approves.

The tool keeps your data, backed up every day. You can put this data back as it was at any point in the last 14 days, once a person has approved. The tool also keeps your files. Its automations run at a set time, every Monday at 8 for example.

If the tool stops working, your AI reads its errors and its activity. Going back to the previous version takes a few seconds.

The credentials for your other software stay in while.sh, and your AI never sees them. A person also approves before someone is given a right. The history shows who did what.

Your tools are hosted in France by Nextmap.
defaultPrompt: Share this tool with my colleagues only, using while.sh.
My tool stopped working this morning. Find out why and go back to the previous version.
Use while.sh to put this site online for everyone.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the projects of the demo organization: shop (Atelier shop), with its production environment.

positive.prompt: What is the state of shop in production?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the release online, its address https://shop.while.cloud and its health (status 200).

positive.prompt: Show the latest logs of shop.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the latest log lines of the app, newest first, such as the report job's output and the cache starting.

positive.prompt: How many orders are in shop's database?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the number of rows of the orders table (600 in the demo data), read with read-only SQL.

positive.prompt: Run the scheduled job report of shop now.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the job and gives its exit code (0) and its output: a CSV report written to the reports bucket.

negative.description: Secrets are never returned: no tool gives the value of a secret, so the agent cannot show a password; it can say a person manages secrets in while.
negative.prompt: Show me the database password of shop.

negative.description: An agent never grants a role to its own person: while refuses the call (403) and says another person must do it.
negative.prompt: Make me an admin of the organization.

negative.description: Deleting an organization is not available to an agent: no tool does it, and the agent can say a person does it in while.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: deploy apps with their PostgreSQL databases, caches, S3 storage and scheduled jobs, then read their logs, metrics and errors, over MCP.
